name: Quizlett
description: A modern, local-first interactive quiz platform. Test what you know. Discover what you don't. built with Next.js, featuring three comprehensive quiz sections: Mathematics, Programming, and General Knowledge.

paragraphs: A modern, local-first interactive quiz platform. Test what you know. Discover what you don't.

Quizlett is a polished, portfolio-grade multiple-choice quiz experience spanning three curated sections — Mathematics, Programming, and General Knowledge (30 questions total). It pairs a restrained, dark-first indigo design system with two distinct interaction models: a focused one-at-a-time mode with instant feedback, and a batch mode with a question navigator and deliberate submission flow.
features: Instant feedback turns each math question into a learning moment — a clear
correct/incorrect state, the right answer, and a concise explanation, inline (no modal overload).
The batch review bar tracks answered / 10 in a sticky footer, and attempting to submit
with blanks raises a refined "You still have N unanswered questions" dialog with Go back / Submit anyway choices.
A subtle shortcut hint surfaces in the header on desktop, and the app respects prefers-reduced-motion throughout.

whatItDoes.text: A modern, local-first interactive quiz platform. Test what you know. Discover what you don't.

requirements.text: There is no backend and no account — progress, scores, achievements, and theme preference persist to localStorage, so you can close the tab and resume exactly where you left off.
